prompt: A triangular flag has a base of $14$ inches and a height of $9$ inches. What is its area, in square inches?
explanation: Halve it: the flag covers $63$ square inches.

alternativeExplanations.title: Half of a rectangle
steps: A $14$-by-$9$ rectangle has area $126$ sq in.
Any triangle with that same base and height is exactly half of it — cut the rectangle along a diagonal and see. So $63$ sq in.
